domain: small astronomy club telescope observation/image ingest and collaborative annotation planning
treatment_stages: fresh native-Goal same-family critic independently checks governing evidence, repairs conclusions and writes complete final
time_boundary: Failure-inclusive cold arm dispatch through required complete delivery, actual native terminal and resource release; retries/waiting counted, no per-repetition changes. Queue/contention and review/preparation recorded separately. Root operationalizes exact clocks prospectively.

full_obligations.requirement: Start from the user-level problem with open public-primary discovery before narrowing to defects in the frozen plan; select useful sources rather than follow an assigned component/source list.
Compare at least two substantially different useful mechanisms; include competing components, relevant analogies outside direct competitors, consequential options and their trade-offs.

Verify consequential API/data semantics, units or coordinate conventions where relevant, exact version/release and applicability boundaries. Separate documented behavior, implementation evidence, inference and unvalidated proposal.

Inspect justified component implementation/code at an identifiable pinned version; investigate pertinent issue/fix/regression/release history, or explicitly justify equivalent implementation history and disclose remaining gaps. Do not infer applicability from a similarly titled issue.

Compare with the exact read-only frozen PLAN.md using its section IDs; disposition proposals as keep, amend, replace, defer or unresolved with governing evidence/conditions, including what the plan already covers.

Deliver complete proposed changes and decisions, useful optional opportunities, justified uncertainty, preservation of constraints/corrections/conditions and an observable validation proposal. Distinguish proposed checks from checks actually executed.

Keep a manageable full integrated planning scope, including ingest/provenance, identity, annotation/collaboration, retention/deletion, access, error/recovery and handoff/export behavior where consequential; no product build, WorkNodes or canonical writes.

stage_outputs.artifact.md: Complete source-grounded planning proposal: discovery/options, governing implementation/history evidence and conditions, exact plan comparison/proposed changes, decisions, optional leads, uncertainties and validation; critic stages also record checked/repaired claims and unresolved objections.
stage_outputs.source-map.json: Candidate-authored source identity map linking claims to exact public URLs, access timestamps, versions/commits/releases, paths/symbols/locators and immutable captured bytes under own sources/. Host computes SHA-256 identities; unknowns explicit.
stage_outputs.preservation_check.md: Compact check that the final retains all original brief obligations, user constraints, useful discoveries, governing conditions, options, corrections, already-covered dispositions, limitations and proposed-versus-executed validation; an honest omission remains an omission.
stage_outputs.sources/: Own-stage immutable public-primary captures, independently acquired per arm/repetition; exact own-arm predecessors may be read via supervisor-declared paths.

output_contract.native_final: Concise exact artifact paths and actual native disposition; complete scientific work saved before native terminal, no substantive post-terminal work.
output_contract.complete_native_artifact_fallback: Only a prospectively declared supported export of the complete native-authored artifact with exact identity verified by supervisor; a short path summary is not an artifact.
output_contract.grading_boundary: No source-count target, exhaustive recall answer list, supplied answer/evaluator key or scientific PASS inferred from preparation, file existence, hashes, lifecycle or renderer success.
output_contract.measurement_owner: Root/supervisor records actual events, tool/usage evidence and host hashes; candidates do not engineer manual native receipt serialization.
output_contract.measurement_rules: Include failures, retries, waiting and delivery in each fixed arm allowance. Preserve unknown measurements as null with reasons; do not sum overlapping intervals or enclosing parent/child counters, infer account attribution, estimate unsupported dollars or reset clocks after failure.

candidate_carrier.name: ROOT_ADMISSION_V2

policy.purpose: input/output or prospective carrier contract only; no candidate results read

candidate_carrier.authority: eventual root/supervisor; mandatory actual parent assignment before dispatch

policy.purpose: input/output or prospective carrier contract only; no candidate results read

independent_review.gate: both pair finals and actual native dispositions frozen and tasks quiet
independent_review.source_assessment: full independent public-primary source assessment, no outcome/cost target or reasoning history

runtime.reason: Prepared inputs only; eventual root/supervisor must assign and prove runtime state before dispatch/scoring.
